buildCommand: rm -rf /tmp/flutter_sdk && git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git --depth 1 -b stable /tmp/flutter_sdk && /tmp/flutter_sdk/bin/flutter config --enable-web && /tmp/flutter_sdk/bin/flutter pub get && /tmp/flutter_sdk/bin/flutter build web --release --dart-define=SUPABASE_URL=$SUPABASE_URL --dart-define=SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=$SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
